text: 摩根大通发表研报指，香港证监会行政总裁梁凤仪透露目标于明年上半年推出房托通(REITs通)，是自2024年提出以来首次公布官方具体时间表，认为虽然存在监管不确定性，正式推出时间或会延迟，但至少目前有更清晰时间表。该行指，投资者对房托通的预期已因长期等待而淡化，相信最新言论或可重新引起市场的期待。按现行南向通纳入标准（恒生综合指数成份股、平均市值逾50亿港元），预期目前有三只香港上市房托将符合资格，包括领展、置富产业信托及冠君产业信托。由于领展是流动性最高的港股REIT，该行相信将成主要受惠者，给予“增持”评级，目标价43港元。
text_en: JPMorgan said in a research report that Hong Kong SFC CEO Julia Leung revealed a target to launch REIT Connect in the first half of next year, the first official specific timetable since it was proposed in 2024. The bank believes that although regulatory uncertainty exists and the official launch may be delayed, at least there is now a clearer timetable. It said investor expectations for REIT Connect have faded due to the long wait, and believes the latest remarks may rekindle market anticipation. Under the current Southbound Stock Connect inclusion criteria (Hang Seng Composite Index constituents, average market capitalization above HK$5 billion), it expects three Hong Kong-listed REITs to currently qualify, including Link REIT, Fortune REIT, and Champion REIT. Since Link REIT is the most liquid Hong Kong-listed REIT, the bank believes it will be the main beneficiary, giving it an Overweight rating and a target price of HK$43.
